Subject: MAP Kickoff & Weekly Checkpoint Cadence — Finerva evaluation

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have weekly checkpoints, clear owners for evaluation work, and an agreed close timeline. Goal is to stay aligned on success criteria and remove blockers quickly.

Proposed: 
- Cadence: weekly 30-minute checkpoint (preferably Tuesdays) for the next 6 weeks
- First checkpoint: Tue, Mar 3, 10:00 AM PT (open to other times)
- Success criteria: performance within 150ms p95 for prioritized routes, embeddings parity on sample set, and SOC2 evidence review completed
- Close target: Contract signature by week of Apr 13 (6-week evaluation window)

Action items for kickoff (first pass):
1) Share MAP draft (owner: me) — attached spreadsheet includes milestones, owners, and dates
2) Provide sample prompts + eval set (owner: Finerva)
3) Security questionnaire & evidence pickup (owner: Finerva + Priyom for Redwood side)
4) Procurement kickoff / PO steps (owner: Alyssa / Finerva procurement)

I've attached a MAP workbook (Finerva_MAP_v1.xlsx) and our security questionnaire for initial review. Please let me know if the cadence or success criteria need adjustment.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth run.

— Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
